title: Additive Synth for Orac
excerpt: We converted the C+G Additive Synth to Orac :) There is now an ADSR page...
content:
We converted the C+G Additive Synth to Orac :) 

There is now an ADSR page as well as the old features: Transpose, 12 presets, 'Filter' Resonance, and 'Filter" Frequency.

Cpu use is minimal as possible but still an expensive module. Works fine with any sequencer and a couple of effects, but avoid using it with other cpu heavy synths and samplers in the same session.

***reminder, this is the organelle specific zip called a .zop, to minimize issues. put this (or upload this) in the patches folder. than scroll to it on the organelle and install!****
